shared_or_similar_visual_information: Shading restricted to parts of a figure by internal boundaries. On the left, use the gray patches at the upper-left and lower-right corners of the rectangle. On the right, use the gray polygon inside rectangle ABDF beneath the segments AC and CE.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The fill selects two corner regions separated by unshaded parts of the rectangle. Right image: It selects the part of the rectangle outside the two unshaded triangular pieces.
Rationales: The left fill selects separated pieces whose areas are accumulated. The right fill selects a connected remainder after excluding the adjacent unshaded pieces.
